'''Uncle Gao''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]].

==Dialogue==
===Daytime===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Uncle Gao:''' *sigh* Ruiyun, you're just a girl. What's joining the [[Midnight Rangers|Rangers]] got anything to do with you?
:'''Uncle Gao:''' What if something happens to you? Then there'd be nothing but this old man left in this family.
:'''Uncle Gao:''' Oh, you wouldn't believe the amount of strings I had to pull to get her a place in the city patrol.
:'''Uncle Gao:''' Do you have any idea how many people are out there right now who want to be in her shoes? Tsk, she should be glad she got the job!
:'''Uncle Gao:''' If she finds out that I was the one who kept her from going to the frontlines, oh boy, she'd probably make a huge fuss over it... *sigh*.
{{Dialogue End}}

===Nighttime===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Uncle Gao:''' How's work been lately? No one said anything strange to you, did they?
:'''Ruiyun:''' Say something strange? Why would anyone do that?
:'''Uncle Gao:''' Nothing, it's nothing.
:'''Ruiyun:''' Dad, I feel like you've been acting a bit weird ever since I started my job.
:'''Uncle Gao:''' Hey, don't you be getting any of that occupational hazard or whatever they call it, all right? You're starting to look at everyone the wrong way.
:'''Ruiyun:''' Are you getting lonely while I'm gone? Do you want me to find someone to keep you company?
:'''Uncle Gao:''' What? What do you mean lonely? I'm just worried about my daughter!
:'''Ruiyun:''' Oh, come on, Dad... I'm an adult now. I can take care of myself, okay?
:'''Uncle Gao:''' Oh, no, you're not. You'll always be a child in your father's eyes.
{{Dialogue End}}
